 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the repeated horizontal palette strip (the same multicolor row repeated).
    palette_row = None
    palette_rows = None
    for r in range(h):
        vals = [v for v in grid[r] if v != 0]
        if len(vals) < 2 or len(set(vals)) < 2:
            continue
        end = r + 1
        while end < h and grid[end] == grid[r]:
            end += 1
        if end - r >= 2 and (palette_rows is None or end - r > palette_rows[1] - palette_rows[0]):
            palette_row = r
            palette_rows = (r, end)
    if palette_row is None:
        raise ValueError('palette strip not found')
    seq = [v for v in grid[palette_row] if v != 0]
    pr0, pr1 = palette_rows
    palette_cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[palette_row]) if v != 0]
    pc0, pc1 = min(palette_cols), max(palette_cols) + 1

    # The shape to replicate is the color-1 object, excluding the palette itself.
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] == 1 and not (pr0 <= r < pr1 and pc0 <= c < pc1)]
    if not points:
        raise ValueError('reference shape not found')
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points) + 1
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points) + 1
    shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points}
    height = r1 - r0
    base_color = grid[r0][next(c for c in range(w) if grid[r0][c] == 1)]
    base_index = seq.index(base_color)

    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for i, color in enumerate(seq):
        top = r0 + (i - base_index) * height
        for dr, dc in shape:
            rr, cc = top + dr, c0 + dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
